description: This Java class 'OutputRedirector' reads lines from an input stream and logs them at INFO level, also detecting error or exception messages to store as errors. It manages a thread for redirecting output and can be stopped to cease logging.

classes.name: OutputRedirector
classes.description: A class that redirects lines from an input stream to a logger, detects error messages, and manages a thread for continuous reading.

methods.name: OutputRedirector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the redirector with input stream, logger name, thread factory, and optional callback.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Reads lines from the input stream, logs them, and detects error or exception messages.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the redirecting process without terminating the thread.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the redirect thread is still running.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns any error detected during reading.
